criteria.observation: The trusted windowsAclRunnerArgs prefix wins before entry resolution. Without that prefix, windowsAclRunnerEntry selects the candidate built entry, otherwise the installed package runner is resolved from this module. An existing candidate returns [process.execPath,entry]; a missing candidate produces the installation-relative source runner and tsx registration/config prefix. confine appends policy arguments, separator and original argv afterwards; describe alone cannot observe this selector.

criteria.observation: Materialization failure cleans acquired temp resources; provider attempts cleanup of all grants/temp, warns on failures and clears maps. Grant.dispose revokes only revocable paths and frees SIDs; standing workspace ACEs remain. This does not prove cleanup succeeded or provide CVG structured cleanup acceptance.

fresh provider does not adopt crash residue

criteria.independent_judgment: Materialization collects cleanup exceptions; provider tries all disposals/removals, clears maps and warns. Grant.dispose revokes only revocable paths and frees SID allocations. Warn/void is not successful-release proof or CVG structured cleanup acceptance.
